properties.description:
THE LESSON: **an instruction that names a field no tool can write is an instruction that will be followed once, badly, by whoever tries hardest to follow it.**

`dec:idea-gap-flows-to-the-dependency` had said since 2026-08-06 exactly how a consumer's levied requirement is recorded — `add_requirement` + `authored_by role=author` + `source` + `provenance: imported` — and closed with "NOTHING IN THE SCHEMA NEEDS TO CHANGE." True. The schema did not need to change; the TOOL did. `add_requirement` accepted neither field.

MEASURED at the moment it was found: 1 of 263 Requirements carried `source`, 1 of 263 carried a non-default `provenance`, and **both were the same node** — written that afternoon through the generic escape hatch by an agent following the instruction. Seven weeks of a specified path, walked once, from outside.

⭐ HOW IT SURFACED, which is the part worth keeping: not a sweep, not a detector. A real consumer levied a real requirement through the dev_reflow2 hub, and the written instructions ran out halfway through being obeyed. `vocabulary_reach.py --check` was green throughout and correctly so — it guards a NEW declared property the surface cannot write, and these were grandfathered.

⇒ THE GATE THAT WOULD HAVE CAUGHT IT DOES NOT EXIST: nothing compares a documented call sequence against the surface that must serve it. That is not proposed here; it is named so the next person sees the shape rather than the instance.

WHAT LANDED: two optional parameters, written through the same `set_optional_props` path `priority`, `concern` and `kind` already use, so omitting them leaves the schema default exactly as it was. Sixteen test files gained two `None`s. One tool's input schema moved and was blessed deliberately.

WHAT WAS DELIBERATELY NOT DONE: `add_capability` has the same missing pair and was left alone — its `provenance: imported` is already used 16 times, so something else reaches it and no path is blocked. Fixing what was measured rather than the family it belongs to.
properties.name: A path this design documented for seven weeks could not be walked without stepping outside it
